source.label: Data East Monday Night Football instruction card

strategy.overview: Complete either ordered drop-target bank to qualify a ball lock, then collect the lit left and right lock shots. With both balls locked, shoot the Long Bomb ramp to release them and start three-ball Multiball. During Multiball, complete the center targets to raise the ramp, then shoot it for the displayed Jackpot.
strategy.simpleOverview: Hit an ordered drop-target bank to light a lock, then shoot the lit left or right lock. Repeat for the other lock. With both balls held, shoot the Long Bomb ramp for three-ball Multiball. During Multiball, complete the center targets to raise the ramp and shoot it for the Jackpot.
strategy.summary: Complete ordered drop targets to qualify the left and right locks, collect both, then shoot the Long Bomb ramp for three-ball Multiball. Complete the center targets to raise the Jackpot ramp and shoot it.

quickInfo.name: Qualify a Lock
quickInfo.summary: Complete the left or right drop-target bank in order.

quickInfo.name: Collect Locks
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the lit left and right lock shots.

quickInfo.name: Start Multiball
quickInfo.summary: With both balls locked, shoot the Long Bomb ramp.

quickInfo.name: Score Jackpot
quickInfo.summary: Complete the center targets to raise the ramp, then shoot it during Multiball.

steps.text: Complete an ordered drop-target bank to qualify a ball lock.
Shoot the lit lock, then repeat the bank-and-lock route for the lock on the other side.
With both balls locked, shoot the Long Bomb ramp to release them and start three-ball Multiball.
During Multiball, complete the center targets to raise the Jackpot ramp, then shoot the raised ramp for the displayed award.

alternatives.title: Play the touchdown route
alternatives.when: Use this from every plunge and when the field-progress shots are safer than the locks.

steps.text: Plunge into a flashing kickoff light for a touchdown or the displayed yardage.
March 100 yards for a touchdown, then shoot through the raised uprights for the extra point.
Loop the uprights again while available to light one million at the Long Bomb ramp.
Inside the 30-yard line, complete the U-P targets to raise the ramp for a field-goal attempt.
Use clean upright loops to improve the football score and build the Long Bomb award.
Return to the drop banks between scoring drives so the physical locks stay in progress.

machineSetup: Confirm whether physical locks are shared between players and how extra ball is configured.
Test both ordered drop banks, both physical lock shots, Long Bomb ramp, center targets, raising uprights and ramp, and kickoff lanes.

cautions.issue: The physical locks can be shared between players.
cautions.response: Check the setup before play and do not assume a ball you qualified will remain available on your next turn.
